summary: Adds a new machine-based Heidenhain Klartext post-processor (heidenhain_post.py) with its own post-processor properties (program_name, tool_axis, rapid_feed_rate, cycle_format, drill_setup_clearance, chip_break_retract, fixture_output, fixture_first_number, output_blk_form), overridden common defaults (.h extension, radius compensation on, no tool-length offset, no drill-cycle translation), and a test module.

pages.reason: Path/Post/scripts/heidenhain_post.py: new machine-based post with POST_TYPE = "machine", get_property_schema() declaring nine Heidenhain-specific properties (choice enumerations for tool_axis, cycle_format, fixture_output) and get_common_property_schema() overriding file_extension='h', supports_tool_radius_compensation=True, output_tool_length_offset=False, drill_cycles_to_translate=''; output is Klartext (BEGIN PGM/BLK FORM/TOOL CALL/L/CC/C/CYCL DEF), not G-code
